notes.general_comments:
The exam paper provided a good balance of questions and challenge for candidates working at this level.
There was uncertainty about the level of organisation of a leaf and the products of anaerobic respiration in
mammals. There was uncertainty about which part of the eye refracts light and the source of progesterone in
pregnancy. Most candidates recognised the xylem as the site of water transport and knew the features of
human male gametes and sexual reproduction. The inheritance questions were well-understood.
